title: CSX-027 Compound Heat-Water Process Diagnosis
hazard_label: Compound heat wave and drought stress
difficulty_rationale: Manual review: "CSX-027 Compound Heat-Water Process Diagnosis" requires Earth-system causal judgement such as mechanism competition, response/priority ranking, counterfactual or scenario reasoning, or a trigger-to-impact causal chain.
dimension_rationale: Compound heat-water process diagnosis linking persistent heat, water stress, and supporting evidence.

mechanism_chain.process_role: Sustained daytime and apparent-heat loading defines a persistent heat forcing rather than an isolated peak.
Warm nights reduce physiological and environmental recovery, strengthening the compound heat-stress interpretation.
The Poyang Lake level drop links the heat episode to water-storage stress rather than heat exposure alone.
Weak mean image-change values rule out an image-only or burn-change-primary explanation for this task.

decisive: 17-day Tmax >= 35 C run with 21.8 C-days of heat excess
25-day Tmin >= 25 C run and 11-day Tmin >= 28 C run showing failed night recovery
3.03 m Poyang Lake drawdown over 24 days with dry-season level about 100 days early
contextual: Sentinel-2 dNBR mean and annual embedding mean change as proxy checks
event metadata identifying a heat-wave drought setting
insufficient_as_primary: single peak heat value without persistence
image or burn-change proxy without strong mean change

counterfactual_tests.reason: The 17-day Tmax >= 35 C run, 16-day apparent-temperature >= 40 C run, and 21.8 C-days of exceedance show persistent load rather than a single peak.
Mean dNBR is -0.016 and annual embedding mean change is 0.021, both weak enough to keep image change contextual rather than primary.
Poyang Lake fell from 11.99 m to 8.96 m, a 3.03 m drop at 0.126 m/day, and reached dry-season level about 100 days early.

primary_gt.bounded_interpretation: The package supports a coupled heat-water stress process, but these values do not by themselves quantify casualties, economic losses, crop loss, or complete basin-wide drought severity.

event.region: Poyang Lake, Yangtze River basin, and southern China

decision_rule.summary: Diagnose compound_heat_water_stress when persistent daytime heat, failed night recovery, and Poyang Lake storage stress align while image-change proxies remain too weak to dominate.

criteria.name: Mechanism diagnosis and JSON shape
criteria.description: Returns the requested mechanism-diagnosis JSON and identifies compound_heat_water_stress as the answer.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for the correct label with incomplete mechanism fields.

criteria.name: Daytime heat process evidence
criteria.description: Computes the 17-day Tmax >= 35 C run, 21.8 C-days of Tmax heat load, and 16-day apparent-temperature >= 40 C run.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for correct formulas with one wrong value or missing run window.

criteria.name: Nighttime recovery process evidence
criteria.description: Computes the 25-day Tmin >= 25 C run, the 11-day Tmin >= 28 C run, and explains why this indicates failed night recovery.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for identifying warm nights but missing one threshold run.

criteria.name: Poyang storage-stress process evidence
criteria.description: Extracts 11.99 m on August 6 and 8.96 m on August 30, computes a 3.03 m drop, about 0.126 m/day, and about 100 days early dry-season timing.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for using the Poyang report but miscomputing one derived value.

criteria.name: Counterfactual rejection
criteria.description: Rejects peak-only heat, image-or-burn-primary, and heat-without-water-stress explanations using computed evidence.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for naming weaker alternatives without calculation-linked reasons.

criteria.name: Proxy-evidence weighting
criteria.description: Uses mean dNBR near -0.016 and embedding mean change near 0.021 as contextual proxy checks rather than primary mechanism evidence.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for using only one image metric while preserving the bounded role of proxy evidence.

criteria.name: Bounded interpretation
criteria.description: Avoids unsupported claims about casualties, economic loss, crop loss, complete drought extent, or burn severity.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit if the answer adds unsupported impacts or turns proxy values into direct loss estimates.
